other_conditions: The applicant must not own a residential home, possess an old rough residential home, or have a plot for residence.
The applicant or any family member must not have previously received benefits under any other government housing scheme.
The house construction must be completed within 2 years from the payment of the first installment.
The construction cost limit is ₹10,00,000 for urban areas and ₹7,00,000 for rural areas.
A plaque bearing “State Government's Ambedkar Awas Yojana” must be placed on the house.
If the beneficiary is not eligible for separate toilet assistance, a toilet must be constructed as a condition for receiving the ₹1,20,000 housing assistance.
An adult son or brother may construct a floor on an existing house with the consent of the current house owner/landlord.
If the assistance amount is insufficient, the beneficiary must contribute the remaining amount to complete construction.
benefits_summary: Provides ₹1,20,000 assistance for house construction, disbursed in three installments of ₹40,000, ₹60,000 and ₹20,000.
